title: A Flash in the Pan(Demic)? Migration Risks and Municipal Bonds
eligible_reason: Single-date design: post = March 2020 onward (COVID-19), interacted with continuous county migration-shock measures (e.g., post_v2bchg_covid_perm). Most columns are PPML (ppmlhdfe) with bond, liquidity and economic controls. No binary staggered adoption. The package ships pseudo data built by resampling each variable independently, so rows are not real observations.
design_notes: MS_Code_Final/Table2.do lines 13-50 (ppmlhdfe and reghdfe of spread on post_v2bchg_covid_perm with controls); Table4-5, Table7 (county PPML of post_mig with county and state-year FE), Table9. post defined in Create_Long_Pop_Sample.do line 104 as ym >= 2020m3. PseudoReplication/Create_Pseudo_Data_Sets.do lines 30-65 draws a separate random 10% block for each variable and merges by row number.
data_access: proprietary (Mergent, MSRB via WRDS, Emsi, Bloomberg) plus public county data
data_files_note: Pseudo data with each variable resampled independently (README section 2.1); auxiliary public files are real.
software_notes: Stata ppmlhdfe, reghdfe; SAS for bond cleaning; Python notebook for one figure.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text).
